name: Blue Spark: Spark Academy
source:
Clara joins an academy for those with special powers known as the Spark. However, little did she anticipate that she would cross paths with an old love.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
克拉拉進入了一所學院，專門招收擁有「火花」這種特殊能力的人。可她怎麼也沒想到，竟會在這裡與昔日的戀人重逢。

［取自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
